```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY ent 'ResolvedParamEntity'>">
  %param;
  <!ENTITY entRef "&ent;">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/base" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns/sub">
  <!-- Leading comment with multiple rare constructs -->
  <sub:child id="1">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA section containing &entRef; and tags <child> ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&entRef;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % extEnt SYSTEM "external.ent">
  %extEnt;
  <!ENTITY baseEnt "Base Entity">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction target="validator" status="active"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://schema.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Comment about namespace and processing instructions -->
  <item xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw data with entities: &baseEnt;
    ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (data)*>
  <!ELEMENT data (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % macroDefs "
    <!ENTITY e1 'First'>
    <!ENTITY e2 '&e1; Second'>
  ">
  %macroDefs;
]>
<?target-pi data="test-mode"?>
<archive xmlns="urn:archive:root" xmlns:meta="urn:archive:meta">
  <!-- Comment block containing markup: <data>not parsed</data> -->
  <meta:info>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA inside metadata with &e2;
    ]]>
  </meta:info>
  <data>&e2;</data>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock)*>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY itemA "Widget A">
  <!ENTITY itemB "Widget B &itemA;">
  <!ENTITY % internalParam "<!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA | sub)*>">
  %internalParam;
  <!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>
]>
<?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Inventory comment explaining entities &itemB; -->
  <stock>
    <![CDATA[
      <sub-element>Raw CDATA block content</sub-element>
    ]]>
    &itemB;
  </stock>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ref1 "Value 1">
  <!ENTITY ref2 "Value 2 &ref1;">
  <!ENTITY % dtdMacro "<!ENTITY complexRef '&ref2; Final'>">
  %dtdMacro;
]>
<?xml-debug level="verbose" target="parser"?>
<document xmlns="http://example.com/ns/doc" xmlns:ns="http://example.com/ns/other">
  <!-- Top comment preceding deep entity and CDATA usage -->
  <ns:section>
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed CDATA region with entities &complexRef; inside
    ]]>
  </ns:section>
  <section>&complexRef;</section>
</document>
